_comment: Command `<COM>_JoinFailed` kojo (Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.11): the act's participants react when a join is refused (wired §7.13 W2: EvaluationPackage.JoinReaction tries `_JoinFailed`, then `_Join`; the caller passes whether the join went through). label: 参与者对加入者的反应（加入被拒绝）
